# T-168 — a deliberately zigzagged route, for the miter-joint question
#
# NOT a plausible walk. Five sawtooth sections whose interior angles are
# 90, 45, 20, 10 and 5 degrees, 30 m tall, separated by 90 m straight runs.
# Generated, not hand-plotted: dx = h * tan(t/2) puts a KNOWN angle at every
# apex, so a screenshot says which angle the renderer starts spiking at.
#
# ⚠ Teeth are 30 m so the cleanup keeps them: the apex sits > SIMPLIFY_TOLERANCE_M
# from its chord, and < SPIKE_MIN_OFFSET_M from its neighbours' median, so
# Douglas-Peucker and rejectSpikes both leave it alone. Verified in Node against
# the app's own drawableSegments before this file was written.
#
# `lat lon`, one point per line. bash tools/replay-route.sh tools/routes/zigzag-angles.txt
